hardware.variant: CIX P1 CD8180; 32 GB; stock BiosV1.5-W20260706-e321056a; no RTC backup battery

scenario: Set the system time with date(1), so that the kernel writes it through EFI SetTime. Restart with shutdown -r now. Input power stays on.
expected: The kernel reads a time within one second of a reference clock and reports no lost clock.
observed: The kernel used EFI runtime services for the RTC and printed no clock warning. After boot, the board clock was 0.007 s ahead of the reference host.
limits: The reference was a networked host compared over SSH, not a disciplined time source.
The kernel truncates the RTC seconds on read, so one boot can lose up to one second.
